name: forgefuel
description: ForgeFul is a responsive, self-hosted fitness and nutrition tracker.It combines workout logging with a food pantry and automatic nutrition calculations. ## Features - Switch between Dashboard, Gym and Kitchen pages - Record exercises, weights, sets and reps - Delete saved workouts - Calculate nutrition based on food weight in grams - Save and delete pantry items  - View wokrout, pnatry and calorie totals - Keep data afer refreshing with localStorage - Responsive desing for desktop and mobile
